title: MC Functions
description: Validates .mcfunction files for correct command syntax and formatting. MCFunction files contain Minecraft commands that execute in behavior packs.

102.title: Invalid Syntax
102.description: Error when a command in the .mcfunction file has invalid syntax. Verify the command follows Minecraft Bedrock Edition command format and all arguments are correct.
102.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the invalid command text

103.title: Leading Slash
103.description: Warning when a command line starts with a forward slash (/). Unlike in-game chat, .mcfunction files should not have leading slashes on commands.
103.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the command with leading slash
